title: Cheapest Cable Network
statement:
A company wants to connect `n` offices with cables. There are `m` possible cables; cable `i` joins two offices and costs `w_i`. Choose some cables so that every office can reach every other one through the chosen cables, and the total cost is as small as possible. It is guaranteed that connecting all offices is possible.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `m`. Each of the next `m` lines contains `u`, `v` and `w`.

## Output
Print the smallest total cost.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 9000`
- `n - 1 <= m <= 9000`
- `1 <= w <= 10^6`
- no two cables join the same pair of offices, and `u != v`
